During the events of the [[Trioculus' Empire|Trioculus crisis]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] used an ancient building as his '''private hideaway''' on the [[Yavin 4/Legends|fourth]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]]. This [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Stone/Legends|stone]] tower had been built approximately five thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] by the [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]], the warrior caste of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Skywalker had installed his bedroom at the top of the tower, just beneath the turret. In this room, a narrow window overlooked the canopy of Yavin 4's rain forest. In this very tower, the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] of the late [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] advised his former [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] to seek out the [[Lost City of the Jedi]].<ref name="LCJ">''[[The Lost City of the Jedi]]''</ref> [[11 ABY/Legends|Six years later]], Skywalker established a new [[Jedi Praxeum|Jedi Academy]] within the ruins of the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]], and he subsequently relocated his quarters.<ref name="Jedi Search">''[[Jedi Search]]''</ref>
